{{Infobox instance |name=Tower of Karazhan |aka=Kara40, Upper Kara |ss=Tower of Kharazan loading screen.png |caption=Tower of Karazhan loading graphic |loc=[[Deadwind Pass]] |race= |boss={{RaceIcon|Nathrezim}} [[Mephistroth]] |type=Raid |level=60 |minlevel=60 |players=40 |key=[[Upper Karazhan Tower Key]] |bosses={{Tower of Karazhan}} }} '''Tower of Karazhan''' is an instance raid located in [[Deadwind Pass]]. Karazhan, once the towering stronghold of the former Guardian of Tirisfal, now hums with magical energy as it perches atop a powerful leyline.
